minutes.headline: Selectmen approved a draft OPEB funding policy to set aside 10% of free cash, pending Finance Committee review
minutes.summary: The board backed an application for regional technical assistance to produce a business brochure and a permitting guidebook. Most of the meeting went to a draft policy for funding retiree health liability, which the board approved subject to Finance Committee review. The town manager also covered the new Facebook page, upcoming forums and the meeting schedule, and the board asked for a log of road moratorium waivers.

suggested_reports.title: OPEB trust deposits
suggested_reports.question: How much should the town deposit each year toward its retiree health liability?

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved a draft policy to fund retiree health liability (OPEB) from a share of certified free cash, subject to Finance Committee review.
The board voted to support and sign a regional technical assistance application for a business brochure and a permitting guidebook.
A member asked for policy wording that commits the Board to request the free cash deposit at Town Meeting.
The board aimed to hold an executive session on the town manager's salary at the January 16th meeting.
The town manager is to provide a periodic log of road moratorium waiver requests.

why_it_matters: The OPEB policy sets how much of the town's free cash goes toward retiree health costs each year, which affects how much is left for other uses and how large the long-term liability grows.
Because the deposit depends on a Town Meeting request, residents may be asked to vote on it, and the policy's wording decides whether that request is expected every year.
watch_next: Finance Committee review of the draft OPEB funding policy.
The January 16th Select Board meeting, where an executive session on the town manager salary is aimed for.
